type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: atk-kernel: Teorema Global reduzido, ZetaSimetria, FreyBeal, Teoria I, curva congruente

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.FermatAux.divisor_comum_fatores
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {a b d : ℤ}, IsCoprime a b → d ∣ a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 → d ∣ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 → d ∣ 2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.FreyBeal.freyCurve_c₄
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (A B : ℚ), (ATK.FreyBeal.freyCurve A B).c₄ = 16 * (A ^ 2 + A * B + B ^ 2)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.FreyBeal.freyCurve_equation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (A B X Y : ℚ), (ATK.FreyBeal.freyCurve A B).toAffine.Equation X Y ↔ Y ^ 2 = X * (X - A) * (X + B)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.FreyBeal.freyCurve_Δ
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (A B : ℚ), (ATK.FreyBeal.freyCurve A B).Δ = 16 * (A * B * (A + B)) ^ 2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.TeoriaI.absorvente_eq_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : MulZeroClass R] {e : R}, (∀ (x : R), x * e = e) → e = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.TeoriaI.divisao_total_colapsa
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : MulZeroClass R] (div : R → R → R), (∀ (x : R), div x 0 * 0 = x) → ∀ (x : R), x = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.TeoriaI.falhaAbsorcao_falsa_em_R
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∃ e, ∀ (x : ℝ), x * e = e

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.TeoriaI.sem_absorvente_nao_nulo
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : MulZeroClass R], ¬∃ e, e ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (x : R), x * e = e

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.TeoriaI.valoresZeroSobreZero_eq_univ
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ATK.TeoriaI.valoresZeroSobreZero = Set.univ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.TeoriaI.zeroSobreZero_nao_unico
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (L : ℝ), ∃ L', L' ≠ L ∧ L' ∈ ATK.TeoriaI.valoresZeroSobreZero

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.TeoriaI.zero_sem_inverso
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : MulZeroOneClass R] [Nontrivial R] (z : R), 0 * z ≠ 1

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.ZetaSimetria.orbita_distinta
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   s.re ≠ 1 / 2 →     s.im ≠ 0 →       s ≠ 1 - s ∧         s ≠ (starRingEnd ℂ) s ∧           s ≠ 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) s ∧             1 - s ≠ (starRingEnd ℂ) s ∧ 1 - s ≠ 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) s ∧ (starRingEnd ℂ) s ≠ 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) s

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.ZetaSimetria.orbita_zeros
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   0 < s.re →     s.re < 1 →       riemannZeta s = 0 →         riemannZeta (1 - s) = 0 ∧ riemannZeta ((starRingEnd ℂ) s) = 0 ∧ riemannZeta (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) s) = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.ZetaSimetria.rh_iff_faixa
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: RiemannHypothesis ↔ ∀ (s : ℂ), 1 / 2 < s.re → s.re < 1 → riemannZeta s ≠ 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.ZetaSimetria.zero_conj
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, riemannZeta s = 0 → riemannZeta ((starRingEnd ℂ) s) = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.ZetaSimetria.zero_fora_da_reta_tem_par_a_direita
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → riemannZeta s = 0 → s.re ≠ 1 / 2 → ∃ w, riemannZeta w = 0 ∧ 1 / 2 < w.re ∧ w.re < 1

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.ZetaSimetria.zero_one_sub
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → riemannZeta s = 0 → riemannZeta (1 - s) = 0
